title: Protocol #07: Pine Resin Wound Healing & Natural Hemostatic Salve
summary: Untreated wilderness lacerations and infected wounds result in fatal sepsis within 48 hours. Formulate a primitive sterile salve utilizing raw pine resin (terpene antimicrobials) and sterile activated charcoal to seal wounds, stop bleeding, and prevent infection.

materials.name: Hardened Pine Resin (PINE RESIN)
materials.desc: Clear amber globules exuded from pine trunk scars. Rich in natural antimicrobial terpenes.

materials.name: Sterile White Ash & Crushed Charcoal (STERILE CHARCOAL)
materials.desc: Ultra-high temp sterile ash and finely pulverized charcoal from hearth core. Adsorbs exudate.

materials.name: Boiled Cloth or Birch Bark Bandage (BIRCH BANDAGE)
materials.desc: Sterilized cloth strip boiled in rolling water or pliable inner birch bark wrapping.

steps.title: Resin Harvest & Gentle Indirect Melting
steps.description: Scrape hardened resin nodules from pine bark using flint or knife. Place on a concave hearth stone and melt slowly using indirect ember heat, skimming out bark debris with a stick.
steps.actionNote: > Action: Pine resin is highly flammable; never place directly over open flames. Melt gently over perimeter coals.

steps.title: Sterile Charcoal Blend & Salve Compounding
steps.description: Blend pulverized sterile charcoal and fine white wood ash into liquid resin at a 3:1 ratio. Stir continuously until it thickens into a pliable black antiseptic wax salve.
steps.actionNote: > Science: Terpene acids disrupt microbial cell membranes while porous activated carbon adsorbs bacterial endotoxins, halting anaerobic tetanus and staph proliferation.

steps.title: Warm Wound Sealing & Birch Bark Dressing
steps.description: Thoroughly irrigate the wound with boiled cooled water. Apply a generous layer of warm (approx 40°C) resin salve over the laceration, securing with sterile birch bark or boiled cloth.
steps.actionNote: > Caution: Never apply molten hot resin to avoid severe burns. Cool to body-warm temperature before skin application.

fatalMistake.title: Fatal Mistake: Applying resin directly over an uncleaned, dirt-contaminated wound.
fatalMistake.description: Pine resin forms an absolute waterproof hermetic seal. Sealing anaerobic bacteria or soil pathogens inside a closed wound pocket accelerates lethal necrotizing fasciitis and septicemia. Always irrigate thoroughly with sterile water before sealing.
fatalMistake.consequence: Outcome: Accelerated anaerobic bacterial bloom and fatal septic shock within 48 hours.
